subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “A seaside town noticed its beach was becoming smaller.”?
options: A river is not just water that must be pushed away quickly.
They are kept because they help people remember what time has taken away.
Others worried about cost, storms, and water pollution.
Storms and rising water had taken away sand year by year.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「A river is not just water that must be pushed away quickly.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「They are kept because they help people remember what time has taken away.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Others worried about cost, storms, and water pollution.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Storms and rising water had taken away sand year by year.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
